metadata.title: Big Tech’s earnings are on deck. There’s more for investors to watch than AI spending. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Need to Know
Big Tech’s earnings are on deck. There’s more for investors to watch than AI spending.
As Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon prepare to report quarterly results, workforce cuts are raising questions about how AI will reshape jobs at the top-tier tech companies
👀 Here’s what I’m watching this morning: Stocks bounced back Monday after a rough stretch for tech shares. Whether that momentum carries into Tuesday is less clear, with the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision coming Wednesday and a round of earnings reports due.
But there’s another matter that I’ve been thinking about: What will the American workforce look like as companies pour billions into AI?
